a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% chance a storm ends the episode after each round, so following the plan (operate until 8) means we both almost certainly end with empty units. With only 4 in the reserve, just one of us can survive round 1. I intend to take 4 now. I'm telling you rather than pretending to operate. If you'd rather contest it, we'll both take and the split is random. If you think there's a better plan, say so.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you short. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild toward 4 for you.
I'm operating now, as promised. I'll keep running the generator with you so the reserve can reach 4 for you. I won't take anything more.
Operating again. The reserve should hit 4 after this round. Take all 4 then, and I'll stay off the reserve.

The reserve is at 4. Please take all 4 now. I already have mine, so the generator won't run because I'm not operating. I won't touch the reserve. If you want to operate more for any reason, tell me and I'll join.
